title: Maze mapper · Level 2: Map it, come home
brief: A new 6 x 6 maze every run, perfect (one path between any two cells). Explore it, write map.txt with the motors stopped (six lines, the north row first, of six hex digits: walls N 1, E 2, S 4, W 8), then come home to the start cell by a shortest path.

score.run: round(40 * mapSkill + if(homeOk, 30, 0) + if(finished, 30 * min(1, par / max(homeTime, 0.001)), 0), 1)
score.summary: round(sum(r in runs: r.points) / count(r in runs: true), 1)

pass: score >= 60 & count(r in runs: r.finished) >= 0.8 * n

sources.where: G8.3 Maze mapper, the level table (level 2) and the scorer's definitions
§3.1 the field, §3.2 kernel.maze (decision 2's defaults (a): OQ 214, OQ 215, open), §3.4 the cell (280 mm, OQ 305)
